Titles.eng: BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia I: Promise
Titles.jpn: BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia I: Yakusoku

Summaries.eng: To reach the stage of "FES.", Yukina Minato decides to form a band. Each holding their own convictions, the members of the band come together. The five girls now begin their journey to the top as Roselia... This is the story of their "promise" made to each other, from the start of the band to their challenge towards FUTURE WORLD FES!
Summaries.jpn: 「FES。」の舞台に立つため、湊雪菜はバンド結成を決意。 それぞれが独自の信念を持って、バンドのメンバーが集まります。 5人の女の子がロゼリアとしてトップへの旅を始めます...これは、バンドの開始からFUTURE WORLD FESへの挑戦まで、お互いに成し遂げられた「約束」の物語です！

Aliases: 劇場版 BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia I: 約束
Gekijouban Bang Dream! Episode of Roselia: Promise
